name: modloc
short: Count lines of code per logical module instead of per repository.
long:
Count lines of code per logical module instead of per repository.

A logical module is the nearest directory holding go.mod (Go) or Cargo.toml
(Rust). Every file counts toward the closest module above it, so nested
modules never add to the module that encloses them. With no <repo>, the
current directory is scanned.
